note: Gate G1: the word-count range of each FORMAT per locale (tags stripped, FAQ included). The calendar's length_target names a format. faq_answer_note: The brief says 30–90, but scripts/seo-audit.js has failed a FAQPage answer outside 25–75 since before this system existed, and it runs against production in CI. A gate must never pass what a later gate fails, so the ceiling is 75. CLAUDE.md's on-page limits say 40–60, which is the editorial target inside this hard range. The two run-1 articles (omra-8-jours-ou-15-jours, prix-omra-maroc-par-gamme-et-mois) predate all of this and fail the live audit at 81–116 words in all three locales — a pre-existing defect, fixed by editing those two posts in the admin.
